scope: Prevent DWG MESH serialization from emitting a nonzero trailing field whose source layout has not been established.

implementation.guard: Reject unknown != 0 before encodeDwgCommon or any output-stream mutation; keep the default zero value admitted pending producer-backed layout evidence.
implementation.failureBehavior: A rejected model leaves data, handle, and string streams empty.

coverage: Generated DWG MESH vectors verify nonzero unresolved-tail refusal before emission across AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.
Every refusal leaves data, handles, and strings empty.
The existing MESH DXF loss guard, geometry and crease domains, malformed crease-count refusal/retry, and face-vector controls pass their focused selectors.
No DWG or DXF fixture files were added.

limitations: The DWG MESH trailing field's physical layout remains unresolved; the guard does not qualify the zero/default profile for producer compatibility.
ODA v5.4.1 does not document an AcDbSubDMesh DWG body, and LibreDWG's peer schema labels its differing tail fields undocumented/unstable.
No modern MESH DWG was found in the 170-file local LibreDWG-readable corpus; the peer Surface.dxf could not be converted to DWG because unrelated records failed.
This guard does not establish MESH geometry, topology, subdivision, crease effects, overrides, or native consumer semantics.
